mentions.name: Polign Recall
mentions.description: Polign Recall provides state and memory management for AI agents, offering append-only state logging and governance. Memory and storage run on a BYOC (bring your own cloud) setup and can work with confidential workloads.
mentions.source_excerpt: Polign Recall, a state and memory management for agents that can provide append only state logging and governance. The memory and storage is completely on BYOC setup and can work with confidential workloads
mentions.author: anuptalwalkar
